criteria.description: Assessment of candidate's professional background and experience relevant to the role.
strong_evidence: Demonstrates substantial experience in finance and accounting roles
Provides detailed accounts of responsibilities and achievements
Shows clarity in articulating past successes
weak_evidence: Failure to connect experience with job requirements

criteria.description: Evaluation of the candidate's technical proficiency in financial software and accounting principles.
strong_evidence: Proficient in required financial management software
Articulates understanding of accounting principles with examples

criteria.description: Ability to navigate challenges in finance-related tasks and solutions offered.
strong_evidence: Describes challenges faced with structured problem-solving approaches
Provides concrete examples showcasing critical thinking
Demonstrates resilience in complex financial scenarios
weak_evidence: Lack of personal accountability in past challenges

criteria.description: Level of effectiveness in communicating financial information to diverse stakeholders.
strong_evidence: Articulates complex ideas clearly and effectively to non-financial individuals
Provides specific examples of successful communication strategies
Shows readiness to adjust communication style as needed
weak_evidence: Struggles to explain financial concepts succinctly
No success stories of stakeholder engagement
